data_objects.name: worker_wage_records
data_objects.meaning: Person-level wage records with experience, education, appearance ratings, job attributes, health, demographic indicators, marital status, and geographic indicators.

variables.name: belavg
variables.meaning: Binary indicator for a below-average appearance category.

variables.name: abvavg
variables.meaning: Binary indicator for an above-average appearance category.

variables.name: union
variables.meaning: Binary indicator of union status or membership.

variables.name: goodhlth
variables.meaning: Binary indicator for the source-defined good-health category.

variables.name: black
variables.meaning: Binary source indicator for a Black racial category.

variables.name: female
variables.meaning: Binary source indicator for a female sex category.

variables.name: south
variables.meaning: Binary indicator for the source-defined southern geographic category.

variables.name: bigcity
variables.meaning: Binary indicator for a large-city category.

variables.name: smllcity
variables.meaning: Binary indicator for a small-city category.

variables.name: expersq
variables.meaning: Squared form of the work-experience quantity.

variables.name: Nservice
variables.meaning: Binary source field labeled Nservice, apparently indicating non-service work.

variables.name: Slooks
variables.meaning: Source-defined combined or transformed appearance field labeled Slooks.

structure.description: Each row is one person-level worker record; no explicit person identifier is present, and many attributes are stored as binary indicators.

uncertainties: The currency and time basis for wage, the logarithm convention for lwage, and the units of exper and educ are not stated.
The appearance-rating scale and the exact construction of Slooks are not documented.
The coding definitions for geographic, health, service, sex, and race indicators are not supplied beyond their column labels.
annotation_notes: Sensitive demographic fields are described as source encodings without extending their definitions.
